stations.title: Radio at the desk
stations.text: A dead channel leaves it off channel 4.

stations.title: Your functions
stations.gap: Nothing put back on an error

stations.title: Team channel
stations.note: Heard, because the radio is back.

captions: At the radio desk, Ailsa asks the laptop to scan the channels for calls.
Today a dead channel stops the scan and the radio is left there, off the team's channel.
You put the radio back and close the log whatever happens, and keep the log whole.
Now the scan stops on the dead channel and the radio goes back to channel 4.
The team's calls are heard again, and a failed save never leaves the log half written.
